_comment: Official-source ladder (§3). Only free, non-DRM, no-login official sources, each verified end-to-end (page -> m3u8 -> #EXTM3U -> variant -> segment; YouTube via oEmbed). Types: resolve | youtube | clientResolve | officialPlayer. Patterns are .NET regexes with a named group 'url' or JSONPath.

resolvers.name: Show TV
resolvers.notes: Official live page (showtv.com.tr/canli-yayin) sets `var videoUrl = "https://ciner.daioncdn.net/showtv/showtv.m3u8?..."` for its Radiant/Daion player. Master+variant+TS segment fetched OK from DE (Leaseweb) with no Referer. The e= param is a stale 2022 timestamp that the CDN ignores (still 200) - ParseExpiry will treat it as expired, so the backend will simply not cache; ttl 900. Page HTML is CDN-cached (max-age=90) so token is shared by all visitors => not IP-bound. Page has no ACAO header.

resolvers.name: Show TV
resolvers.notes: 200, no X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors.

resolvers.name: Show Max
resolvers.notes: Official live page embeds hope-video JSON with JSON-escaped src (ciner-live.ercdn.net/showmax/playlist.m3u8?e=<now+~2h>&st=...). Master/variant/segment verified from DE, no Referer needed. Same Ciner ercdn token scheme as Show Turk (not IP-bound as far as observable; single egress IP available, so not cross-IP tested). ttl 900.

resolvers.name: Show Max
resolvers.notes: 200, no X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors.

resolvers.name: Show Turk
resolvers.notes: Sister channel (Ciner). Page embeds hope-video JSON with JSON-escaped src (https:\/\/ciner-live.ercdn.net\/showturk\/playlist.m3u8?e=<now+~2h>&st=...); backend unescapes \/. Master/variant/segment verified. e= expiry ~2h ahead; ttl 900. Also present unescaped as `showturkVideoUrl` on showtv.com.tr/canli-yayin. Token observed valid in a CDN-cached copy generated for another visitor => not IP-bound.

resolvers.name: Bloomberg HT
resolvers.notes: bloomberght.com/tv loads /build/common/live-stream.js (site also requests it with ?v=<build>; the unversioned URL returns the same 872 KB bundle) which contains `var DE="https://ciner.daioncdn.net/bloomberght/bloomberght.m3u8?e=1649424566&st=...&app=...&ce=3"`. The e= is a stale 2022 value ignored by the CDN. Master/variant/segment verified from DE, no headers. A second URL in live-tv-player-box.js (ciner-live.ercdn.net/bloomberghtmobil) is expired (403) - pattern deliberately targets daioncdn only. Minified var name may change on rebuild; the host-anchored pattern does not depend on it.

resolvers.name: CNN Turk
resolvers.notes: The site's own player (category.bundle.js) calls /api/cnnvideo/media?id=<live content id 62d6814670380e2cdc7c124c> and plays ServiceUrl + SecurePath. SecurePath is RELATIVE (/S2/HLS_LIVE/cnnturknp/playlist.m3u8?&live=true&app=com.cnnturk&st=...&e=<now+~3h>): it must be resolved against $.Media.Link.ServiceUrl = https://live.duhnet.tv (extra field baseUrl), NOT against apiUrl. Verified master/variant/segment 200 from DE with no headers; untokenized or tampered st => 403. Response echoes "UserIp":"<requester IP>" so the st signature is presumed IP-bound (could not test from a 2nd IP) => ipBound true. API has ACAO:*; the duhnet CDN returns ACAO only for https://www.cnnturk.com (browser hls.js from another origin would be blocked; native players fine). The raw Path in the page HTML (live.duhnet.tv//S2/.../playlist.m3u8 without st) is 403.

resolvers.name: CNN Turk
resolvers.notes: @cnnturk / youtube.com/cnnturk (linked from cnnturk.com), verified. channel/<id>/live currently resolves to EECLl-EvqnM (isLive true, oEmbed 200, embeddable) but that live started 2026-09-24 19:33 UTC and is a programme, not a 24/7 stream - so use embed/live_stream?channel=UCV6zcRug6Hqp1UX_FdyUeBg, which may be offline between programmes.

resolvers.name: CNN Turk
resolvers.notes: Same API as the resolve entry, to be fetched by the user's app because the st token is presumed bound to the requester IP. CORS: GET with Origin: https://rimatv.github.io -> Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on the API. Note the duhnet CDN playlist responses only allow Origin https://www.cnnturk.com, so in-browser hls.js playback from another origin fails; native players are unaffected.

resolvers.name: Global News
resolvers.notes: globalnews.ca/live/national/ sets gncaVideoPlayerSettings.jw.feedUrl=/gnca-ajax-redesign/video-entry/{"id":"49a91e7f-..."}/ ('Global News National - 24/7 Live Stream', drm:false). $[0].sources[0].file = https://content.news.corusappservices.com/templates/media/smil/49a91e7f-...?delivery_protocol=hls&metafile=false which 302-redirects to https://live.corusdigitaldev.com/groupd/live/49a91e7f-.../live.isml/.m3u8 (ACAO:*, no token). Following the redirect: master/variant/segment verified, PROGRAM-DATE-TIME current. Not geo-blocked from DE at time of test. Backend must follow redirects before the #EXTM3U check.

Candidate YouTube channels (1TVNewsAF UC5OAzwSyeBbeoih0093O45Q, '1TV Afghanistan' UC_fLaumcoJY9eE9oYohIakg, '1TV Kabul' UCNYssWlc1i2oC54Tive3c2g) exist but none had a live stream at test time (channel/<id>/live returned the channel page, no isLive), and which one is the broadcaster's official channel could not be confirmed from an official site.
